newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Yields fall on six-month Lithuanian T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on six-month Lithuanian T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell on six-month Lithuanian Treasury bills at Tuesday's auction and all of the 50 million litas issue, which had been oversubscribed, was sold, the central bank said.
The average yield on the 179-day paper was 10.08 percent, down from the 10.84 percent offered at the last auction with a similar maturity, for 182-days, on April 15.
Settlement date for the issue is May 5 and the bills mature on October 31.
